{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Zeng Feiyang, the director of the Panyu Center, has been arrested and placed under criminal detention on charges of “disrupting public order”.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Zhu Xiaomei, a key worker activist, has been arrested and placed under criminal detention on charges of “disrupting public order”.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Zhu Xiaomei played a leading role in assisting workers at the Lide Shoe factory.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Zhu Xiaomei played a leading role in assisting sanitation workers.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Zhu Xiaomei has been separated from her one-year-old daughter while breastfeeding.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Several staff and activists from four worker centers remain in detention.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Those detained are being held incommunicado.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Those detained are being refused their right to see lawyers.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Local government authorities in the Guangdong province are panicked by the growth of unofficial protests and strikes by migrant workers.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Migrant workers in the Guangdong province are suffering from the closures or relocations of their workplaces.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Authorities appear to be trying to deprive workers of their right to support or representation by jailing those who have offered them legal support and advice.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Numerous labor unions and worker rights activists based in Hong Kong have been organizing a campaign of protest.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The campaign of protest is in support of colleagues on the Mainland.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
